WITH filtered_ab AS (
  SELECT abhvreg, translink, peercorr
  FROM advancedbehavior
  WHERE peercorr >= 0.149
),
matched AS (
  SELECT fab.translink, tr.ordertypedist
  FROM filtered_ab fab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON fab.translink = tr.transreg
),
with_filter AS (
  SELECT translink, ordertypedist
  FROM matched
  WHERE ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
),
counts_per_combo AS (
  SELECT translink, ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM with_filter
  GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist
),
totals_per_type AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, SUM(cnt) as total_cnt
  FROM counts_per_combo
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  cpc.translink,
  cpc.ordertypedist,
  cpc.cnt,
  CAST(cpc.cnt AS FLOAT) / tpt.total_cnt as fraction
FROM counts_per_combo cpc
JOIN totals_per_type tpt ON cpc.ordertypedist = tpt.ordertypedist
ORDER BY fraction DESC, cpc.translink
LIMIT 10
